text:
maya: quick design review — updated playground stream mockups are in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/playground-stream-session (see frames A/B). main changes: compact token meter, floating stop/regenerate, and prompt shelf integration. could use UX eyes on placement + copy. trent: glance looks good. question on stop vs pause semantics — do we stop generation entirely (clear stream) or pause to allow resume? sam: for product we want a clear "stop" that ends the run (keeps partial output) and a separate "regenerate" action that starts a new run. pausing/resuming adds complexity to runtime. rachel: agree with sam. Accessibility note: if stop is destructive, label should be explicit e.g. `Stop generation (keeps current text)` — people misclick. also need keyboard focus order. maya: yep — plan is: Stop (single tap, retains text), Regenerate (new run). UI: small floating pill at bottom-right of message bubble with token meter collapsed. open to wording tweaks. trent: token meter: current design shows absolute counts `345/2048` which feels noisy. can we show a small progress arc + hover tooltip with exact tokens? mobile should have a condensed pill `345` only. sam: +1 to condensed. Would like to see a threshold color change at 80% of configured max seq. green -> amber -> red. rachel: on screen readers: make sure token meter has aria-live updates (polite) and an accessible name like `Token usage 345 of 2048` instead of just `345`. Also ensure the floating controls are in the DOM order so keyboard users hit them naturally. maya: noted. for hover/tooltips we can add `role=\"tooltip\"` and for the meter `aria-valuenow` etc. prototype snippet: ```
345
``` a11y-bot: automated check: ensure the floating pill has at least 4.5:1 contrast with background and target hit area >=44x44px for touch. trent: placement debate — floating inside message bubble vs docked to bottom rail. pros: inside bubble feels contextual for that response; cons: it can overlap selection and makes keyboard navigation weird. rachel: if we choose inside bubble, add an explicit focus trap for the controls so tab order doesn't skip. maybe show controls on focus/hover only to reduce clutter. sam: variance across density settings? we have compact/comfy modes. compact => icon-only meter + small stop button. comfy => text + meter. keep consistent across playground and API console. maya: copy options for stop/regenerate microcopy: a) `Stop` / `Regenerate`, b) `Stop generation` / `Regenerate response`, c) `Stop (keep text)` / `Regenerate` — leaning to b for clarity. feedback? rachel: b is fine. b plus tooltip on first-run explaining difference. trent: prompt shelf integration: when a prompt template is inserted mid-stream, do we re-evaluate token cost before allowing insert? i.e., warn users if new prompt will push tokens over limit. sam: yes — compute delta tokens on insert and show a subtle warning pill `+120 tokens — may truncate`. give inline option `Insert anyway` or `Trim`. maya: good idea. I'll update flows. any objections to making the floating controls appear on hover/focus only and a persistent small token badge otherwise? rachel: no objections. just ensure persistent badge is accessible and announced on focus. trent: small nit: when regenerate is clicked while streaming, should we animate a quick collapse of old stream then start a spinner — avoids mixing outputs. sam: agree. also keep a lightweight toast `Regenerating response` for secondary confirmation. maya: I'll push a new figma with these tweaks (hover/focus behaviors, aria attrs, color thresholds, prompt-insert token delta). thanks all — tagging @design-review for follow-up. :thumbsup: trent: thanks — will do a quick pass on keyboard flows tomorrow. rachel: I'll run the a11y checklist against the new frames once you post. a11y-bot: reminder scheduled: run automated contrast + focus-order check when new frames are uploaded.
